positions.statement: On his campaign website, Hutchison lists restoring elections confidence among his legislative goals.

verification.note: Domain confirmed by Voters' Pamphlet (p.39, www.haroldhutchison.carrd.co). Listed under "My legislative goals".

positions.statement: Willamette Week reported in its October 2026 legislative endorsements that Hutchison said doctors who perform abortions are evil.
positions.excerpt: He said doctors who perform abortions are evil.

source.publisher: Willamette Week, WW's Fall 2026 Endorsements: Oregon Legislature

verification.note: Willamette Week, "WW Staff", 2026-10-14. Page reads "He said doctors who perform abortions are evil." in the Hutchison section. Statement attributes the report to WW and does not assert it as his own words beyond what WW reports. WW does not give the date or setting of the remark.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race or-senate-15 swept 2026-10-19. Hutchison 2 items (1 T2, 1 T3); Muñoz 8 items (T2). Hutchison's own pamphlet and a lightly populated campaign site limited his material; the abortion item is press reporting, WW being the only outlet. Not a search-effort gap.
